name: Social Insurance (Bảo hiểm xã hội)

configuration.limitation: Law on Social Insurance 41/2024/QH15 art.33 and art.34 — 8% employee and 17.5% employer, on a salary capped at 20 times the statutory reference level (2,530,000, ceiling 50,600,000). The employer 17.5% is 3% sickness and maternity, 14% retirement and survivorship, and 0.5% occupational accident and disease under the Law on Occupational Safety and Hygiene 84/2015/QH13 art.44 with Decree 58/2020/NĐ-CP art.4. Floor: Luật BHXH 41/2024/QH15 Điều 31(1)(đ) — tiền lương làm căn cứ đóng thấp nhất bằng mức tham chiếu (2,530,000 đ on this version). an employer granted the reduced 0.3% occupational-accident rate (Decree 58/2020 art.5) records the entity fact `occupational_accident_reduced`; its share is then 17.3%. Law 41/2024/QH15 art.31(1)(b) with Decree 158/2025/NĐ-CP art.7(1)(a)–(c): the insurance salary is the monthly job or title wage, plus the wage allowances and the other supplements of a stated amount agreed in the contract and paid regularly and stably each pay period, excluding items that depend on or vary with productivity, work history or performance (`terms.fixed_allowances`, the standing rows marked fixed); a row marked not fixed stays outside. Circular 06/2021/TT-BLĐTBXH, cited here before, was repealed from 1 July 2025 by Circular 12/2025/TT-BNV art.20(2)(b). Above the ceiling (twenty times the reference level) the employer’s share is the ceiling at the employer’s own rate — 17.3% where the occupational-accident fund is reduced (Decree 58/2020 art.4), 17.5% otherwise — the same choice the open rungs make. The base recorded is the insurance salary itself — the contractual salary floored at the reference level (2530000.0) and capped at twenty times it (50600000.0) — so a scheme that reads `produced.SI.base` reads the insured salary. Unpaid-leave continuation: Law 41/2024/QH15 arts.33(5) and 34(3) permit continuation by agreement at the most recent contribution base; art.31(1)(đ) sets the bounds at contribution time. The dated registration records the agreement, reference and prior base. Decree 158/2025/NĐ-CP art.43(2) retains occupational-accident contributions on the compulsory SI salary. https://xaydungchinhsach.chinhphu.vn/toan-van-luat-so-41-2024-qh15-bao-hiem-xa-hoi-119240723163650489.htm https://xaydungchinhsach.chinhphu.vn/toan-van-nghi-dinh-158-2025-nd-cp-quy-dinh-ve-bao-hiem-xa-hoi-bat-buoc-119250629171336803.htm Law 41/2024/QH15 art.33(5) limits the unpaid-month waiver to the listed categories, excluding part-time employees under art.2(1)(l); art.33(6) requires SI in the first working or return month with at least 14 sickness-benefit working days. Benefit eligibility and return-month status are dated declarations. BHXH letter 371/BHXH-QLT of 7 July 2025 section 1.2 counts a paid half-day as a working day; the threshold counts fully unpaid working dates, not summed wage-deduction fractions. https://cdn.thuvienphapluat.vn/uploads/Hoidapphapluat/2025/LNMT/Thang_7/250707/QLT-%C4%90VSDL%C4%90.pdf Maternity contributions: Law 41/2024/QH15 art.53(8) exempts birth, adoption under six months, surrogate-birth and commissioning-mother benefit leave without imposing 14 working days; other maternity-benefit cases are exempt only from 14 working days in the month. The dated eligibility and category elections distinguish statutory benefit leave from ordinary unpaid absence. Article 53(1), Circular 12/2025/TT-BNV art.9(4)(c) require compulsory SI after an early return from birth leave while the maternity allowance continues. Official application (birth leave starting 14 August 2025 is exempt that month): https://chinhsachonline.chinhphu.vn/xac-dinh-thoi-gian-lam-viec-de-dong-bhxh-82176.htm Circular: https://xaydungchinhsach.chinhphu.vn/toan-van-thong-tu-12-2025-tt-bnv-quy-dinh-chi-tiet-mot-so-dieu-cua-luat-bhxh-ve-bhxh-bat-buoc-11925070415595016.htm Law 41/2024/QH15 art.2(7)(b) — a domestic worker (lao động là người giúp việc gia đình, `employment.type` DOMESTIC) is not a compulsory participant, so the SI base, and the union fund that reads it, is nil for one. Law 41/2024 art.2(2)(b): a foreign employee at retirement age is measured at the contract’s signing against the age Decree 135/2020 art.4 sets for that year (men 60y3m in 2021 rising 3 months a year to 62 in 2028; women 55y4m in 2021 rising 4 months a year to 60 in 2035), read on `employment.service_start`. Law 41/2024/QH15 art.2(1)(a) covers a fixed-term contract only “từ đủ 01 tháng trở lên”; a fixed-term contract of under one full month (`employment.contract_months` < 1) is outside SI, so its base is nothing and the union fee and dues that read `produced.SI.base` follow; the employer owes the worker the equivalent with the wage (Labour Code art.168(3), `INSURANCE_EQUIVALENT`). Decree 135/2020/NĐ-CP art.4 with Annex I (signed text https://datafiles.chinhphu.vn/cpp/files/vbpq/2020/11/135.signed.pdf pp.1–3, read visually) sets the retirement age by the month and year of birth — the age of the year in which the worker reaches it (a man born 7/1964 retires at 61y3m in 10/2025) — so the foreign-worker retirement exclusion compares the age at signing with the Annex I age for `employee.birth_date`, not with the age of the signing year. Engine: the insurance salary is floored at the reference level 2,530,000 and capped at 50,600,000 (20 × the reference level). An employer with the entity fact occupational_accident_reduced pays 17.3%; every other employer 17.5%. Engine: a month with 14 or more unpaid working days (period.unpaid_working_days) charges nothing (Law 41/2024 art.33(5)) unless the SI election unpaid_leave_continuation records the agreement to continue.

name: Health Insurance (Bảo hiểm y tế)

configuration.limitation: Law on Health Insurance 25/2008/QH12 art.13 as amended by Law 51/2024/QH15, in force 1 July 2025, with Decree 188/2025/NĐ-CP art.6(1)(a) (from 1 July 2025, art.70(2); it repealed Decree 146/2018/NĐ-CP, art.70(4)(a), (5)) — 4.5% of the monthly compulsory-SI salary, the employer two-thirds (3%) and the employee one-third (1.5%), on the same 20 times reference level ceiling as social insurance (50,600,000). Floor: Luật BHXH 41/2024/QH15 Điều 31(1)(đ) — tiền lương làm căn cứ đóng thấp nhất bằng mức tham chiếu (2,530,000 đ on this version). Law 41/2024/QH15 art.31(1)(b) with Decree 158/2025/NĐ-CP art.7(1)(a)–(c): the insurance salary is the monthly job or title wage, plus the wage allowances and the other supplements of a stated amount agreed in the contract and paid regularly and stably each pay period, excluding items that depend on or vary with productivity, work history or performance (`terms.fixed_allowances`, the standing rows marked fixed); a row marked not fixed stays outside. Circular 06/2021/TT-BLĐTBXH, cited here before, was repealed from 1 July 2025 by Circular 12/2025/TT-BNV art.20(2)(b). The base recorded is the insurance salary itself — the contractual salary floored at the reference level (2530000.0) and capped at twenty times it (50600000.0) — so a scheme that reads `produced.HI.base` reads the insured salary. Where an unpaid-leave agreement continues compulsory SI, health insurance continues on that SI base. Vietnam Social Security guidance, 18 June 2026: https://baohiemxahoi.gov.vn/tintuc/Pages/linh-vuc-bao-hiem-xa-hoi.aspx?CateID=168&ItemID=26671 Health Insurance Law art.12(2)(b), as amended by Law 51/2024/QH15 from 1 July 2025, transfers HI payment to the social-insurance fund for at least 14 sickness-benefit working days, or benefit leave for a listed long-term illness. This remains fund-paid when SI is mandatory in the first working or return month or voluntarily continued. https://congbao.cdnchinhphu.vn/CongBaoCP/VanBan/2025/2/44464/55506-1-2025539-54022-vbhn-vpqh.pdf Law 41/2024/QH15 arts.8(2)(b) and 84(2)(c), with Health Insurance Law art.12(2)(b) as amended by Law 51/2024/QH15, transfer HI payment to the social-insurance fund only for maternity-benefit leave of at least 14 working days in the month. An early return resumes payroll HI; shorter special-category leave can be SI-exempt under art.53(8) while payroll HI remains due. Official BHXH guidance on early return SI and HI: https://baohiemxahoi.gov.vn/chuyen-trang-bhxh-bhyt/tu-van-hoi-dap/Pages/default.aspx?ItemID=5831 Law 41/2024 art.2(2)(b): a foreign employee at retirement age is measured at the contract’s signing against the age Decree 135/2020 art.4 sets for that year (men 60y3m in 2021 rising 3 months a year to 62 in 2028; women 55y4m in 2021 rising 4 months a year to 60 in 2035), read on `employment.service_start`. Health Insurance Law art.12(1)(a) as amended by Law 51/2024/QH15 covers a fixed-term contract only from one full month; under one full month (`employment.contract_months` < 1) the base is nothing (Labour Code art.168(3) equivalent instead). Decree 135/2020/NĐ-CP art.4 with Annex I (signed text https://datafiles.chinhphu.vn/cpp/files/vbpq/2020/11/135.signed.pdf pp.1–3, read visually) sets the retirement age by the month and year of birth — the age of the year in which the worker reaches it (a man born 7/1964 retires at 61y3m in 10/2025) — so the foreign-worker retirement exclusion compares the age at signing with the Annex I age for `employee.birth_date`, not with the age of the signing year. Engine: the insurance salary is floored at 2,530,000 and capped at 50,600,000.

name: Unemployment Insurance (Bảo hiểm thất nghiệp)

configuration.limitation: Law on Employment 74/2025/QH15 arts.31 to 33 — 1% of the employee's monthly wage and 1% of the employer's monthly wage fund, on a wage capped at 20 times the regional minimum wage (Decree 293/2025/NĐ-CP, unchanged on 1 July 2026). The scheme covers Vietnamese employees; a foreign employee is outside it. Law 41/2024/QH15 art.31(1)(b) with Decree 158/2025/NĐ-CP art.7(1)(a)–(c): the insurance salary is the monthly job or title wage, plus the wage allowances and the other supplements of a stated amount agreed in the contract and paid regularly and stably each pay period, excluding items that depend on or vary with productivity, work history or performance (`terms.fixed_allowances`, the standing rows marked fixed); a row marked not fixed stays outside. Circular 06/2021/TT-BLĐTBXH, cited here before, was repealed from 1 July 2025 by Circular 12/2025/TT-BNV art.20(2)(b). The UI wage is defined in the same words, and capped at 20 times the regional monthly minimum wage the Government publishes at the time of contribution (Law 74/2025/QH15 art.34(1)(b), (2)). Law 41/2024 art.31(1)(đ) makes the unemployment-insurance base the social-insurance base, so its floor is the version’s reference level — 2,530,000 from 1 July 2026 as for SI, not the earlier 2,340,000. Law 74/2025/QH15 article 33(4) separately exempts months with at least 14 unpaid working days from UI; an SI continuation agreement does not remove that exemption. https://xaydungchinhsach.chinhphu.vn/toan-van-luat-viec-lam-119250711173403835.htm Fully unpaid working dates determine the unpaid-day threshold; a paid half-day remains a working day under BHXH letter 371/BHXH-QLT of 7 July 2025 section 1.2. Law 74/2025/QH15 art.33(4) exempts UI only when the worker has at least 14 working days without salary; the special SI maternity categories do not create a shorter UI exemption. a domestic worker is outside unemployment insurance — Law 38/2013/QH13 art.43(1) to 31 December 2025, Law 74/2025/QH15 art.31(2) from 1 January 2026 (`employment.type` DOMESTIC). Law 74/2025 art.31(2) excludes an employee who already qualifies for a pension, not only one drawing it — the UI election `pension_qualified`. Foreign employees: Law 41/2024 art.2(2)(b) measures retirement age at the contract’s signing, against the age Decree 135/2020 art.4 sets for that year (men 60y3m in 2021 rising 3 months a year to 62 in 2028; women 55y4m in 2021 rising 4 months a year to 60 in 2035). Law 74/2025/QH15 art.31(1)(a) covers a fixed-term contract only from one full month; under one full month (`employment.contract_months` < 1) the base is nothing (Labour Code art.168(3) equivalent instead). Law 74/2025/QH15 art.31(2) (Government full text, read 2026-09-28) also excludes a worker “đang làm việc theo hợp đồng thử việc” — on a probation contract (`employment.type` PROBATION) the UI base is nothing. Decree 135/2020/NĐ-CP art.4 with Annex I (signed text https://datafiles.chinhphu.vn/cpp/files/vbpq/2020/11/135.signed.pdf pp.1–3, read visually) sets the retirement age by the month and year of birth — the age of the year in which the worker reaches it (a man born 7/1964 retires at 61y3m in 10/2025) — so the foreign-worker retirement exclusion compares the age at signing with the Annex I age for `employee.birth_date`, not with the age of the signing year. From 1 January 2026: Decree 374/2025/NĐ-CP art.5(1) (Official Gazette 48 of 23 January 2026, DOCX text read 2026-09-30, https://congbao.chinhphu.vn/van-ban/nghi-dinh-so-374-2025-nd-cp-468724.htm) reduces the employer’s UI share from 1% to 0% for a newly hired worker with a disability, while the worker works, for at most the first 12 months from the hire; art.5(2) requires the employer to register that worker with the social-insurance agency with a copy of the disability certificate (the election `disabled_new_hire_relief` with `disability_certificate_reference`). The worker’s 1% is unchanged. Owner rule 2026-09-28 defaults (the decree is silent): the 12 months are the hire month and the eleven after it (`employment.service_months` < 12), which never exceeds 12 contribution months; and only a hire on or after 1 January 2026, the decree’s commencement (art.45(1)), is “tuyển mới” under it — lawful because the full 1% is the ordinary rate and never under-pays the fund. Engine: Vietnamese citizens only (residency_status CITIZEN); floored at 2,530,000 and capped at 20 × the Region I minimum wage (5,310,000 → 106,200,000). The cap is 20 × the version’s regional minimum wage for the entity region (rules.minimum_wage.by_region[company.region]); an entity without a recorded region is capped at the Region I figure. Engine: a month with 14 or more unpaid working days charges nothing (Law 74/2025 art.33(4)); an SI continuation agreement does not change it.

The worker’s 1% is unchanged. Owner rule 2026-09-28 defaults (the decree is silent): the 12 months are the hire month and the eleven after it (`employment.service_months` < 12), which never exceeds 12 contribution months; and only a hire on or after 1 January 2026, the decree’s commencement (art.45(1)), is “tuyển mới” under it — lawful because the full 1% is the ordinary rate and never under-pays the fund.

name: Trade Union Fee (Kinh phí công đoàn)

configuration.limitation: Law on Trade Unions 50/2024/QH15 art.29, in force 1 July 2025 — an employer levy of 2% of the social-insurance salary fund, payable whether or not a union has been established, on the same 20 times reference level ceiling (50,600,000). Floor: Luật BHXH 41/2024/QH15 Điều 31(1)(đ) — tiền lương làm căn cứ đóng thấp nhất bằng mức tham chiếu (2,530,000 đ on this version). Law 41/2024/QH15 art.31(1)(b) with Decree 158/2025/NĐ-CP art.7(1)(a)–(c): the insurance salary is the monthly job or title wage, plus the wage allowances and the other supplements of a stated amount agreed in the contract and paid regularly and stably each pay period, excluding items that depend on or vary with productivity, work history or performance (`terms.fixed_allowances`, the standing rows marked fixed); a row marked not fixed stays outside. Circular 06/2021/TT-BLĐTBXH, cited here before, was repealed from 1 July 2025 by Circular 12/2025/TT-BNV art.20(2)(b). Law on Trade Unions 2024 art.29(1)(b) (Decree 105/2026/NĐ-CP, in force 16 May 2026, which replaced Decree 191/2013): the employer’s union fund contribution is 2% of the salary fund on which social insurance is paid — one line on the establishment, the sum of the insured salaries (`produced.SI.base` over the run), not a charge on any payslip. Decree 105/2026/NĐ-CP (signed 31 March 2026, in force 16 May 2026; signed text https://datafiles.chinhphu.vn/cpp/files/vbpq/2026/4/105-ndcp.signed.pdf, read visually) art.2(1), reciting Law 50/2024 art.29(1)(b) as amended by Law 97/2025/QH15 art.2(8): the payers are enterprises, public service units not paid 100% of their salaries from the State budget, cooperatives and unions of cooperatives, and other employers — a State enterprise pays the same 2%, and a fully budget-paid unit is not a payer (outside the template’s employers). Art.12: after an art.13 suspension ends, a VGCL or provincial federation decision on a qualifying workforce cut reduces the fee by at most 20% for at most 6 months (entity fact `union_fee_reduction_percent`); art.13: a decision for restructuring, technological change, economic crisis or natural disaster suspends it for at most 12 months (entity fact `union_fee_suspended`). Record either as a dated entity-fact revision for the decision’s months. The art.11 exemption waives only unpaid arrears on dissolution or bankruptcy, not a run line. Engine: 2% of each employee's insurance salary (floored at 2,530,000, capped at 50,600,000). A suspension (entity fact union_fee_suspended) charges nothing; a reduction by decision (union_fee_reduction_percent, at most 20) lowers the 2% by that share (Decree 105/2026 arts.12–13). Engine: the fee is 2% of the SI salary fund, so a month the employee is out of SI for 14 or more unpaid working days (Law 41/2024 art.33(5)) adds nothing.

name: Personal Income Tax (Thuế thu nhập cá nhân)

refuse_when.message: Vietnam PIT needs the tax residence on the contract terms (CITIZEN, PERMANENT_RESIDENT, RESIDENT or NON_RESIDENT); the law presumes neither residence nor non-residence.

rules.when: person.residency_status != "NON_RESIDENT" && employment.exit_date != "" && employment.start_date != "" && calendar_completed_months(employment.start_date, add_days(employment.exit_date, 1)) < 3 && ((has(scheme.elections.commitment_form) && scheme.elections.commitment_form == true) || base.assessed < 5000000.0)

rules.employee: round(ladder(max(0.0, base.assessed - ((has(charged.month.SI) ? charged.month.SI.employee : 0.0) + (has(charged.month.HI) ? charged.month.HI.employee : 0.0) + (has(charged.month.UI) ? charged.month.UI.employee : 0.0)) - min(has(scheme.elections.voluntary_pension_contribution) ? double(scheme.elections.voluntary_pension_contribution) : 0.0, 3000000.0) - 15500000.0 - 6200000.0 * (has(scheme.elections.dependants) ? double(scheme.elections.dependants) : 0.0)), [[10000000.0, 0.05], [30000000.0, 0.10], [60000000.0, 0.20], [100000000.0, 0.30], [null, 0.35]]), 1.0, "HALF_UP")

configuration.limitation: Law 109/2025/QH15, Decree 253/2026/ND-CP and Circular 87/2026/TT-BTC (in force 1 July 2026, resident salary from tax period 2026; its art.6(2) replaces Circular 111/2013/TT-BTC) for the 2026 rules; Personal Income Tax Law 04/2007/QH12 and Circular 111/2013/TT-BTC only where this text contrasts the earlier rule. Declared non-residents receive 20% withholding on taxable remuneration without resident personal, dependant or insurance deductions; that rule precedes the resident short-contract withholding rule and does not require a rate override. Resident progressive withholding uses the version’s monthly scale and deduction amounts; the configured year-end rule reconciles annual withholding. Before 1 July 2026, non-residents retain the earlier overtime-premium exemption and taxable leave cash-out. The full qualifying overtime and statutory cessation leave exemptions apply to residents from tax year 2026 and non-residents from 1 July 2026 (Decree 253/2026 arts.26 and 69). A future departure does not establish cessation in the current period. Payments beyond statutory limits remain taxable. Special tax profiles require further verification. Tax residence is a fact the employer records: a resident is present 183 days in the calendar year or twelve months from arrival, or has a registered permanent residence or a rented home for 183 days or more (Decree 253/2026 art.4), and anyone else is non-resident (art.5); neither the Law nor the decree presumes either for an unknown residence, so an unrecorded residence stops the calculation (`terms.tax_residency`). Residence governs the whole tax period (art.66(1)(a): the calendar year, or the first twelve months from arrival): each month is withheld on the status recorded for it (art.46(3), art.64(4): income is taxed when paid), and a change of status during the year is settled in the annual finalisation, which re-prices the year’s wage income on the resident table and credits what was withheld at 20% (art.51; Decree 126/2020 art.8(6)(d)); earlier months are never re-withheld. Leave cash-out: art.26(2) exempts the pay for untaken leave only within the Labour Code art.113(3) conditions and rate (the Decree 145/2020 art.67(3) day), and art.26(3) taxes the excess; income is taxed in the month it is paid (art.46(3)), so an excess is income of the paying month and is never spread over earlier periods. Meal: Decree 253/2026 art.8(2)(g) with art.69(1)(b) — from 1 July 2026 a meal paid by the employer is taxable only above 1,200,000 a month; a meal served in kind is not income. A class counting toward PIT.MEAL enters the base only above that cap. Housing: rent, power and water the employer pays on the worker’s behalf is taxable at the amount paid but not above 15% of the worker’s other taxable income at the unit (Decree 253/2026 art.8(2)(h)); a class counting toward PIT.HOUSING enters at the lower of the two. Voluntary pension and life insurance: deducted as paid, at most 3,000,000 a month in total including the employer’s share, from tax year 2026 (Decree 253/2026 art.46(2)(a) with art.69(1)(a)), read from the dated VOLUNTARY_PENSION deduction claims; the annual settlement allows twelve months’ cap. The art.49 medical, education and charity deductions are not withheld monthly: a taxpayer who claims them settles with the tax office personally (Decree 253/2026 art.51(3)), so the employer never applies them. Year-end: the December re-pricing on the annual table is the employer’s finalisation, which it may make only for an employee who authorised it and qualifies (Decree 126/2020 art.8(6)(d); Decree 253/2026 art.51(2)): the PIT election `finalisation_authorised`. Without it December is withheld on the monthly table. Night work: Decree 253/2026 art.26(1) exempts "tiền lương, tiền công làm việc ban đêm" — the wage for night work itself, where Circular 111/2013 art.3(1)(i) exempted only "phần tiền lương, tiền công trả cao hơn" the day wage; Decree 145/2020 art.56 prices the night-work wage as the ordinary hour × night hours plus at least 30% of it. The ordinary night hours' share of the salary (`NIGHT_WAGE`) leaves the base beside the premium for every employee. Engine: Law 109/2025/QH15 art.29(2) — the five-rung monthly scale applies to salary income from the 2026 tax period (5% to 10,000,000; 10% to 30,000,000; 20% to 60,000,000; 30% to 100,000,000; 35% above); Resolution 110/2025/UBTVQH15 — personal deduction 15,500,000 and 6,200,000 per registered dependant a month from the 2026 tax period. Taxable income is the month's PIT base less the employee's compulsory SI 8% + HI 1.5% (and UI 1% for a citizen) computed on the same base within the insurance floor and caps — exact for a salary-only month, an over-deduction in a month carrying a bonus outside the insurance salary — less the personal and dependant deductions. Dependants are the PIT election dependants — the dependants registered with the tax authority (scheme.elections.dependants). Non-residents: 20% of taxable income, no deductions. Insurance deducted is the employee's compulsory SI, HI and UI actually charged in the month (charged.month), exact in a bonus month (Law 109/2025/QH15 art.8(2); Law 04/2007 art.15 before 2026). From 1 July 2026 (Decree 253/2026/NĐ-CP): employee contributions to supplementary or voluntary pension and life insurance are deducted up to 3,000,000 a month (art.46(2)(a); PIT election voluntary_pension_contribution); a resident with no contract or one under three months (employment.start_date to exit_date) is withheld 10% on a payment of 5,000,000 or more, nothing below it or with the commitment form (art.50(2); election commitment_form).

name: Đoàn phí công đoàn (union membership dues)

rules.employee: round(min(max(0.0, month.ordinary - (has(charged.month.SI) ? charged.month.SI.employee : 0.0) - (has(charged.month.HI) ? charged.month.HI.employee : 0.0) - (has(charged.month.UI) ? charged.month.UI.employee : 0.0) - (has(charged.month.PIT) ? charged.month.PIT.employee : 0.0)) * 0.005, 253000.0), 1.0, "HALF_UP")

configuration.limitation: Trade Union Law 50/2024/QH15 art.29 with Decision 61/QĐ-TLĐ (in force 1 July 2025): a union member in an enterprise outside the State sector pays dues of 0.5% of the salary the compulsory social insurance is based on, capped at 10% of the base salary (mức lương cơ sở); paid to the union, never by a non-member. ( this sentence gave the 1% of the superseded Decision 1908/QĐ-TLĐ art.23, which no version here applies.) The `union_member` election says who is one. Law 41/2024/QH15 art.31(1)(b) with Decree 158/2025/NĐ-CP art.7(1)(a)–(c): the insurance salary is the monthly job or title wage, plus the wage allowances and the other supplements of a stated amount agreed in the contract and paid regularly and stably each pay period, excluding items that depend on or vary with productivity, work history or performance (`terms.fixed_allowances`, the standing rows marked fixed); a row marked not fixed stays outside. Circular 06/2021/TT-BLĐTBXH, cited here before, was repealed from 1 July 2025 by Circular 12/2025/TT-BNV art.20(2)(b). Quyết định 61/QĐ-TLĐ of the Vietnam General Confederation of Labour, in force from 1 July 2025, cut the dues of a member in an enterprise outside the State sector to 0.5% of the salary the compulsory social insurance is based on, capped at 10% of the base salary (mức lương cơ sở) — the 1% of Decision 1908/QĐ-TLĐ no longer stands on any version here. https://pbgdpl.cantho.gov.vn/quyet-dinh-61qd-tld-ve-dieu-chinh-giam-muc-dong-doan-phi-cong-doan https://nhandan.vn/chinh-thuc-giam-muc-dong-doan-phi-cong-doan-tu-172025-post898504.html [DEC61] art.1 (city-portal transcription) waives dues only for a member on SI benefit for a month or more, or without work, income or pay for a month or more — not for the 14 unpaid working days that end the month’s SI contribution (Law 41/2024 art.33(5)); such a member still pays 0.5% of the insurance salary (the contractual salary and fixed supplements within the reference-level floor and ceiling). A member outside compulsory SI pays a set sum of at least 0.5% of the base salary; the union sets it, and the seed charges that minimum, 0.5% of 2530000.0. Owner rule 2026-09-28 (law silent on a part month): the waiver applies to a pay month in which every scheduled working day is wholly unpaid; maternity-benefit months stay waived as SI’s own exemption. [DEC61] art.1 waives dues only for a member on SI benefit for a month or more. A month with SI nil is now waived as a benefit month only for a birth, adoption, surrogate-birth or commissioning-mother maternity spell (the categories whose whole leave the SI rule already exempts by `maternity_category`; a birth spell is months long); a paternity spell (at most 14 working days, art.53(2)) or a short maternity event (miscarriage, check-up, contraception) no longer waives the dues, which fall on the insurance salary unless every scheduled working day of the month is wholly unpaid (fund-paid benefit days are wholly unpaid days on the payslip). Decree 135/2020/NĐ-CP art.4 with Annex I (signed text https://datafiles.chinhphu.vn/cpp/files/vbpq/2020/11/135.signed.pdf pp.1–3, read visually) sets the retirement age by the month and year of birth — the age of the year in which the worker reaches it (a man born 7/1964 retires at 61y3m in 10/2025) — so the foreign-worker retirement exclusion compares the age at signing with the Annex I age for `employee.birth_date`, not with the age of the signing year. Engine: members only — 0.5% of the insurance salary, at most 253,000 (10% of the reference level). Membership is the UNION_DUES election union_member (scheme.elections.union_member); a non-member is never charged. In a State-owned enterprise (entity fact state_owned_enterprise) the dues are 0.5% of the take-home salary after SI, HI, UI and PIT, same cap (Decision 61/QĐ-TLĐ); the scheme is assessed after PIT for that reason.
